systems.owner: National Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (NIEBC); NOVA GROUP named as the company responsible for the system's digital infrastructure
systems.tiers: 54 registration centres in 16 of Mogadishu's 20 districts from 15 April to 30 September 2025 (918,890 voters after duplicates removed), extended to Dhusamareeb, Baidoa, Jowhar and Las Anod

systems.country_label: NIRA registration centres at district offices
systems.tiers: registration centres at district offices in Mogadishu

note: A policy paper on the 2025 biometric voter registration in Mogadishu, an electoral register the typology puts out of scope. Its only bearing on civil registration is in passing: district offices are named as where birth certificates and national ID services are given, and passports, national IDs or birth certificates as identification asked of 38% of polled registrants. It says nothing of how a birth or death is recorded, so no fact is taken.
